style: Flat vector cartoon illustration in a playful picture-book style: bold simple shapes, clean dark outlines, bright saturated colors, soft flat shading, uncluttered background. One clear focal action that tells the whole story at a glance, with expressive faces. Landscape format, 3:2 (1536×1024). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the image.

items.fr: En dix minutes, le petit robot a [rangé] toute la chambre.
items.en: In ten minutes, the little robot tidied up the whole bedroom.
items.zh: 十分钟里，小机器人把整个房间收拾好了。
items.scene: A small cheerful robot with several arms stands in the middle of a child's bedroom. The left half of the room is still a chaotic mess of toys and clothes; the right half is already perfectly tidy, with books lined up on the shelf and clothes folded. The robot is putting the last teddy bear into a toy box.
items.hook: 一半乱、一半整齐，机器人正把东西放回原位：ranger = 整理、把东西放到该放的地方。

items.fr: Ma grand-mère [emprunte] dix romans par semaine à la bibliothèque.
items.en: My grandmother borrows ten novels a week from the library.
items.zh: 我奶奶每周从图书馆借十本小说。
items.scene: A tiny, energetic grandmother pushes a shopping trolley piled with a towering stack of library books out of a public library. Behind the desk, the librarian stares in amazement. Each book has a little library card sticking out of it.
items.hook: 书从图书馆“借进来”，以后要还：emprunter（qch à qn）= 借入；借出去是 prêter。

items.fr: Le pingouin [prête] son écharpe au flamant rose qui grelotte.
items.en: The penguin lends his scarf to the shivering flamingo.
items.zh: 企鹅把自己的围巾借给冻得发抖的火烈鸟。
items.scene: On a snowy landscape, a friendly penguin holds out his long red striped scarf to a pink flamingo that is shivering with cold, knees knocking. A small luggage tag hangs from the scarf, showing a circular 'return' arrow symbol.
items.hook: 围巾从企鹅手里递出去，还挂着“要还”的标签：prêter qch à qn = 借出；借进来是 emprunter。

items.fr: L'ours polaire s'est vite [habitué] au soleil de Marseille.
items.en: The polar bear quickly got used to the Marseille sunshine.
items.zh: 北极熊很快就习惯了马赛的阳光。
items.scene: A polar bear lounges happily in a deck chair on a sunny Mediterranean beach, wearing sunglasses and sipping a cold drink. Next to him, an abandoned electric fan and a melted bucket of ice show he no longer needs them.
items.hook: 本来怕热的北极熊，现在悠闲地晒太阳：s'habituer à = 从不适应到适应。

items.fr: Elle a [démissionné] pour faire le tour du monde à vélo.
items.en: She resigned to cycle around the world.
items.zh: 她辞了职，要骑自行车环游世界。
items.scene: Outside a grey office tower, a joyful young woman throws her office ID badge and a pile of papers into the air. She is already sitting on a fully loaded touring bicycle with a rolled-up world map. In an office window, her boss watches open-mouthed.
items.hook: 工牌一扔、骑车离开公司：démissionner = 自己主动辞职；被辞退是 être licencié。

items.fr: Le [syndicat] des facteurs défile pour de meilleurs salaires.
items.en: The postal workers' union marches for better pay.
items.zh: 邮递员工会上街游行，要求提高工资。
items.scene: A crowd of postal workers in identical blue uniforms and caps march shoulder to shoulder in a city street behind one large banner decorated only with a raised fist and a coin symbol. One of them speaks through a megaphone.
items.hook: 同一行业的人穿着同样的制服、团结在同一面旗帜下：syndicat = 工会。

items.fr: Le médecin montre le [foie] : il est juste sous les côtes, à droite.
items.en: The doctor points to the liver: it is just under the ribs, on the right.
items.zh: 医生指着肝脏：它就在身体右侧的肋骨下方。
items.scene: A friendly doctor points with a pen at a large, colourful anatomy poster of a human torso. Only the liver is highlighted in rich reddish-brown and glows; the other organs are pale. The liver sits under the ribs on the right side of the body.
items.hook: 看清它在身体里的位置：foie = 肝。别和 foi（信仰）、fois（次）弄混。

items.fr: Le perroquet voyage toujours sur l'[épaule] du pirate.
items.en: The parrot always travels on the pirate's shoulder.
items.zh: 鹦鹉总是站在海盗的肩膀上旅行。
items.scene: A cheerful pirate with an eye patch stands on the deck of a ship. A colourful parrot sits proudly on his shoulder, which is lit as the focal point of the picture.
items.hook: 鹦鹉站的地方就是 épaule（肩膀）。

items.fr: Après dix ans à Lyon, Mei a obtenu la [citoyenneté] française.
items.en: After ten years in Lyon, Mei obtained French citizenship.
items.zh: 在里昂生活了十年后，梅取得了法国国籍。
items.scene: In a French town hall decorated with a blue-white-red flag, a smiling young Asian woman proudly holds up a new passport with a plain cover and a certificate, while her family and friends applaud behind her.
items.hook: 入籍仪式、新护照、三色旗：citoyenneté = 公民身份，国籍。

items.fr: Tout le monde a [droit] à l'école, même la petite fille du village.
items.en: Everyone has the right to school, even the little girl from the village.
items.zh: 每个人都有上学的权利，村里的小女孩也不例外。
items.scene: At sunrise, a little girl with a backpack walks proudly up a dirt path towards a small village school whose doors are wide open, with warm light streaming out. A teacher waits at the door with open arms.
items.hook: 校门对每个人敞开：avoir droit à qch = 有……的权利。

items.fr: Les [inégalités] grandissent : l'un a un gâteau entier, les autres une miette.
items.en: Inequality is growing: one has a whole cake, the others a crumb.
items.zh: 不平等在加剧：一个人有一整个蛋糕，其他人却只有一点碎屑。
items.scene: At one end of a long table, a single well-dressed man sits in front of an enormous layered cake. At the other end, a crowd of people lean over one tiny plate holding a single crumb. The table is tilted like a seesaw towards the cake.
items.hook: 一边一整个蛋糕，一边只有一点碎屑：inégalité = 不平等。

items.fr: Chaque hiver, l'association lutte contre la [pauvreté] en servant des repas chauds.
items.en: Every winter, the charity fights poverty by serving hot meals.
items.zh: 每到冬天，这个协会都会提供热饭，帮助人们摆脱贫困。
items.scene: On a snowy winter evening, warm-hearted volunteers serve steaming bowls of soup and hand out blankets to a respectful queue of people in worn coats. The scene is dignified and kind.
items.hook: 冬夜里排队领热饭的人：pauvreté = 贫穷；lutter contre la pauvreté = 扶贫。

items.fr: Le gâteau est magnifique ; [cependant], personne n'ose le goûter.
items.en: The cake looks magnificent; however, nobody dares to taste it.
items.zh: 蛋糕很漂亮，然而没有人敢尝一口。
items.scene: A gorgeous, towering birthday cake decorated with flowers sits on a party table, but it gives off a faint green smoke. All the guests lean back, holding their noses and refusing politely with their hands.
items.hook: 前半句说好（漂亮），后半句一转（没人敢吃）：cependant = 然而。

items.fr: Je n'ai pas envie de sortir ; [d'ailleurs], mon chat dort sur moi.
items.en: I don't feel like going out; besides, my cat is asleep on me.
items.zh: 我不想出门，再说，我的猫正趴在我身上睡觉。
items.scene: A person relaxes on a cosy sofa under a blanket while rain pours outside the window. A big fluffy cat sleeps peacefully on their lap. By the door, a coat and an umbrella hang unused.
items.hook: 已经有一个理由（下雨），再补一个理由（猫在睡）：d'ailleurs = 再说，而且。

items.fr: Le chien a mangé les douze croissants ; [autrement dit], plus de petit-déjeuner.
items.en: The dog ate all twelve croissants; in other words, no more breakfast.
items.zh: 狗吃光了十二个可颂；换句话说，没早饭了。
items.scene: In a sunny kitchen, a guilty-looking dog sits next to an empty bread basket, croissant crumbs all around its mouth. At the breakfast table, the family stare at their empty plates.
items.hook: 同一件事换个说法：“可颂被吃光” = “没早饭了”，autrement dit = 换句话说。

items.fr: Mon frère déteste la plage ; [en revanche], il adore la montagne.
items.en: My brother hates the beach; on the other hand, he loves the mountains.
items.zh: 我哥哥讨厌海滩，却很喜欢山。
items.scene: A split image of the same young man. On the left, he sits grumpily on a crowded beach, sunburnt and covered in sand. On the right, he stands beaming on a snowy mountain summit with his arms raised.
items.hook: 左边一张苦脸，右边一张笑脸：en revanche = 相反，另一方面。

items.fr: Avec trois chats, il faut [davantage] de croquettes.
items.en: With three cats, you need more kibble.
items.zh: 养了三只猫，就需要更多猫粮。
items.scene: A woman struggles to carry a gigantic sack of cat food into her kitchen while three cats wait in a row in front of three bowls. On the counter, a tiny old box of cat food looks ridiculously small.
items.hook: 从一小盒到一大袋：davantage = 更多。

items.fr: [Désormais], on paie avec son téléphone, même au marché.
items.en: From now on, people pay with their phones, even at the market.
items.zh: 如今，人们用手机付款，连在集市上也是如此。
items.scene: At a colourful open-air vegetable market, an elderly vendor proudly holds out a card reader while a customer taps it with a smartphone. Beside the stall, an old metal cash box sits covered in cobwebs.
items.hook: 旧钱箱结了蜘蛛网，新方式从此开始：désormais = 从今以后。

items.fr: [Auparavant], cette usine était grise ; aujourd'hui, c'est un jardin.
items.en: Previously, this factory was grey; today, it's a garden.
items.zh: 以前，这座工厂灰扑扑的；如今，它是一座花园。
items.scene: An old brick factory with tall chimneys has been turned into a lush garden full of flowers, trees and people having picnics. In the foreground, a hand holds an old faded black-and-white photo of the same factory, grey and smoky.
items.hook: 手里那张黑白旧照片就是“以前”：auparavant = 以前，过去。

items.fr: Le chef pose le gâteau et le chien saute [aussitôt] dessus.
items.en: The chef puts the cake down and the dog immediately jumps on it.
items.zh: 厨师刚把蛋糕放下，狗就立刻扑了上去。
items.scene: A chef's hands are still holding the plate he has just set on the table, and a dog is already in mid-leap towards the cake, with speed lines behind it. The chef's hat flies off in surprise.
items.hook: 手还没离开盘子，狗已经扑到了：aussitôt = 立刻，马上。

items.fr: [Peu à peu], le petit gland est devenu un grand chêne.
items.en: Little by little, the little acorn became a big oak.
items.zh: 小橡子一点一点地长成了一棵大橡树。
items.scene: A left-to-right sequence on a single hill: an acorn in the soil, a small sprout, a young sapling, a medium tree and finally a huge, majestic oak. The same squirrel appears at each stage, growing older.
items.hook: 从左到右一步步长大：peu à peu = 逐渐，一点一点地。

items.fr: Il y a [environ] mille bonbons dans ce bocal : devinez combien !
items.en: There are about a thousand sweets in this jar: guess how many!
items.zh: 这个罐子里大约有一千颗糖：猜猜到底有多少！
items.scene: At a village fair, a giant glass jar packed with colourful sweets stands on a table. A group of children squint at it, counting on their fingers and scratching their heads.
items.hook: 数不清，只能估个大概：environ = 大约。

items.fr: [Grâce à] un chien de sauvetage, on a retrouvé le randonneur perdu.
items.en: Thanks to a rescue dog, the lost hiker was found.
items.zh: 多亏一只搜救犬，人们找到了迷路的徒步者。
items.scene: In deep mountain snow, a big Saint Bernard rescue dog proudly leads a team of rescuers to a cold but relieved hiker. The hiker hugs the dog gratefully.
items.hook: 好结果归功于谁：grâce à = 多亏；坏结果用 à cause de。

items.fr: [Au lieu de] faire ses devoirs, Léo construit une fusée en carton.
items.en: Instead of doing his homework, Léo is building a cardboard rocket.
items.zh: 莱奥没有做作业，而是在用纸板造火箭。
items.scene: In a child's bedroom, a pile of homework lies abandoned on a desk with a big red cross over it. A dashed arrow leads from the homework to a boy wearing a colander as a helmet, sitting triumphantly in a cardboard-box rocket with crayon flames.
items.hook: 本该做的事被打叉，箭头指向他真正在做的事：au lieu de + 本该做却没做的那件。

items.fr: [Malgré] la tempête, le facteur livre le courrier en sifflant.
items.en: Despite the storm, the postman delivers the mail, whistling.
items.zh: 尽管暴风雨肆虐，邮递员仍吹着口哨送信。
items.scene: In a fierce storm with lightning and slanting rain, a cheerful postman in a yellow raincoat whistles happily, holding a dry letter high above his head, while his umbrella is blown inside out. A yellow letterbox waits nearby.
items.hook: 伞都被吹翻了（障碍），他照样笑着送信（结果不变）：malgré + 挡不住的障碍。

items.fr: [Lors de] leur mariage, le gâteau est tombé par terre.
items.en: During their wedding, the cake fell on the floor.
items.zh: 在他们的婚礼上，蛋糕掉到了地上。
items.scene: At an elegant wedding reception, a tall white wedding cake is caught in mid-fall from its trolley. The bride and groom gasp with their hands over their mouths, and the guests freeze in shock.
items.hook: 某个特定场合里发生的事：lors de = 在……的时候（比 pendant 更正式）。

items.fr: Je te prête mon vélo, [à condition que] tu le rendes propre.
items.en: I'll lend you my bike, provided that you give it back clean.
items.zh: 我把自行车借给你，条件是你还回来时要保持干净。
items.scene: One friend hands a shiny new bicycle to another, with a raised warning finger. Above them, a thought bubble shows two pictures: the bike coming back spotless with a green tick, and the bike coming back covered in mud with a red cross.
items.hook: 有条件的约定（干净 ✓，满是泥 ✗）：à condition que + 虚拟式（tu rendes）。

items.fr: Le chat dort au soleil, [tandis que] la souris fait la fête.
items.en: The cat sleeps in the sun, while the mouse is partying.
items.zh: 猫在阳光下睡觉，而老鼠正在开派对。
items.scene: An image split vertically down the middle. Left: a sunny yellow scene with an orange cat curled up asleep in a patch of sunlight. Right: a dark disco with a mirror ball and coloured lights, where a mouse in a party hat dances wildly.
items.hook: 画面劈成两半，两边同时发生又截然相反：tandis que = 而（同时对比）。

items.fr: [Bien qu']il soit tout petit, le chihuahua fait peur au facteur.
items.en: Although he is tiny, the chihuahua frightens the postman.
items.zh: 虽然吉娃娃个头很小，却把邮递员吓坏了。
items.scene: A tiny chihuahua barks ferociously at a garden gate, while a big, tall postman has leapt onto the top of a letterbox in terror, clutching his bag.
items.hook: “虽然很小”却“把大个子吓坏”：bien que + 虚拟式（soit）= 虽然。

items.fr: Il se lève à cinq heures [afin de] voir le soleil se lever au sommet.
items.en: He gets up at five so as to see the sun rise from the summit.
items.zh: 他五点起床，为了在山顶看日出。
items.scene: A hiker with a glowing headlamp reaches a mountain summit just as a spectacular golden sun rises over a sea of clouds. Down in the valley, a tiny tent and an alarm clock show the early start.
items.hook: 起早是手段，看日出是目的：afin de + 不定式 = 为了。

items.fr: Les enfants veulent aller à la plage ; [quant au] chat, il préfère dormir.
items.en: The children want to go to the beach; as for the cat, he prefers to sleep.
items.zh: 孩子们想去海滩；至于猫，它更喜欢睡觉。
items.scene: An excited family loads a car with buckets, spades and beach balls, while the family cat sleeps soundly, curled up in a beach bag that nobody can use.
items.hook: 先说一群人，再单独说另一个：quant à（au / aux）= 至于。

items.fr: Saurez-vous trouver le chat [parmi] tous ces hiboux ?
items.en: Can you find the cat among all these owls?
items.zh: 你能在这群猫头鹰中找到那只猫吗？
items.scene: A big tree full of owls sitting on every branch, all looking the same. Hidden among them, one cat with round eyes is trying very hard to look like an owl.
items.hook: 在一群里面找一个：parmi = 在……之中（三个以上）。

items.fr: Le loup a tellement [faim] qu'il voit des sandwichs à la place des moutons.
items.en: The wolf is so hungry that he sees sandwiches instead of sheep.
items.zh: 狼饿极了，看见羊就像看见三明治一样。
items.scene: A skinny wolf hides behind a bush, drooling, with his stomach growling. In front of him, a flock of sheep grazes, but in the wolf's eyes each sheep has turned into a giant sandwich.
items.hook: 饿到看什么都像吃的：avoir faim = 饿（用 avoir，不用 être）。

items.fr: À la récré, Lucas [échange] son sandwich contre une pomme d'amour.
items.en: At break time, Lucas swaps his sandwich for a toffee apple.
items.zh: 课间休息时，卢卡斯用自己的三明治换了一个糖苹果。
items.scene: In a school playground, two children face each other, each handing over an item at the same moment: a boy gives a sandwich and a girl gives a shiny red toffee apple. Two curved arrows cross between them.
items.hook: 两样东西交叉互换：échanger qch contre qch = 用……换……

items.fr: Leur [rencontre] a eu lieu sous la pluie, sous le même parapluie.
items.en: They met in the rain, under the same umbrella.
items.zh: 他们在雨中相遇，共撑着同一把伞。
items.scene: At a rainy bus stop, two strangers share one umbrella and look at each other shyly for the first time. Little hearts float softly in the rain around them.
items.hook: 第一次见面的那一刻：rencontre = 相遇，见面（动词 rencontrer）。

items.fr: M. et Mme Dupont ont [divorcé] : même le chien a deux maisons.
items.en: Mr and Mrs Dupont got divorced: even the dog has two houses.
items.zh: 杜邦先生和太太离婚了：连狗都有两个家。
items.scene: A house sawn neatly in half, each half painted a different colour and moving apart. A confused dog sits in the middle with two kennels, one on each side.
items.hook: 一个家被一分为二：divorcer = 离婚（divorcer de qn）。

items.fr: À la soirée des couples, Paul est le seul [célibataire]… avec son chat.
items.en: At the couples' party, Paul is the only single one… with his cat.
items.zh: 在情侣聚会上，保罗是唯一的单身者……身边只有他的猫。
items.scene: At a party, couples dance in pairs under string lights, while in the middle one man happily slow-dances alone, holding his cat in his arms.
items.hook: 别人成双成对，只有他一个人：célibataire = 单身的。

items.fr: Le seul [témoin] du vol de la tarte, c'est le perroquet.
items.en: The only witness to the theft of the pie is the parrot.
items.zh: 偷馅饼事件的唯一目击者是那只鹦鹉。
items.scene: In a small courtroom, a parrot stands on the witness stand, pointing a wing dramatically at a dog in the dock whose face is covered in pie crumbs. A judge leans forward to listen.
items.hook: 亲眼看见、出庭作证的那一位：témoin = 证人，目击者。

items.fr: Le chien a l'air [coupable] : il a de la crème plein le museau.
items.en: The dog looks guilty: his snout is covered in cream.
items.zh: 狗一脸心虚：它的嘴鼻上沾满了奶油。
items.scene: A dog sits with his ears down and eyes looking sideways, his snout covered in whipped cream, next to an empty cake plate on the floor.
items.hook: 证据就在鼻子上：coupable = 有罪的，有过错的。

items.fr: Le chat prend un air [innocent], mais le vase est cassé juste à côté.
items.en: The cat puts on an innocent look, but the vase is broken right beside him.
items.zh: 猫摆出一副无辜的样子，但碎花瓶就在它旁边。
items.scene: A cat sits upright with huge sweet eyes and a halo-like innocent expression, while right next to him lie the pieces of a broken vase, spilled water and flowers.
items.hook: “一脸无辜”和旁边的碎花瓶：innocent = 无辜的（un air innocent 装无辜）。

items.fr: La [découverte] d'un œuf de dinosaure a stupéfié les chercheurs.
items.en: The discovery of a dinosaur egg amazed the researchers.
items.zh: 恐龙蛋的发现让研究人员惊讶不已。
items.scene: At a desert excavation site, two palaeontologists brushing away the sand jump back in astonishment as a giant egg they have uncovered starts to crack, and a tiny baby dinosaur peeks out.
items.hook: 挖出来的那一刻：découverte = 发现（动词 découvrir）。

items.fr: Pour son expérience [scientifique], Léa fait exploser un volcan.
items.en: For her science experiment, Léa makes a volcano erupt.
items.zh: 为了做科学实验，莱娅让模型火山喷发了。
items.scene: At a school science fair, a girl wearing big safety goggles and a lab coat proudly presents her model volcano, which erupts with a huge fountain of pink foam. Classmates cheer.
items.hook: 护目镜、实验、喷发：scientifique = 科学的。

items.fr: Seul le chat [mince] passe entre les barreaux ; le gros reste coincé.
items.en: Only the slim cat gets between the bars; the fat one stays stuck.
items.zh: 只有瘦猫能穿过栏杆，胖猫却卡住了。
items.scene: Two cats at a garden fence: a slim, elegant cat slips easily through the narrow gap between the bars, while a big round cat is stuck halfway, its belly squeezed.
items.hook: 胖瘦一对比：mince = 苗条的，瘦的。

items.fr: Il a [oublié] de mettre son pantalon avant la réunion en ligne.
items.en: He forgot to put on his trousers before the online meeting.
items.zh: 他开线上会议前忘了穿长裤。
items.scene: A man sits at a desk in a video call: the laptop screen shows colleagues, and above the desk he wears a smart suit jacket and tie. Below the desk he is wearing only boxer shorts with hearts and bunny slippers. His cat stares at him from the floor.
items.hook: 镜头里西装领带，桌下只有短裤：oublier de + 不定式 = 忘了做某事。

items.fr: Grand-père se [souvient] de son premier vélo comme si c'était hier.
items.en: Grandpa remembers his first bike as if it were yesterday.
items.zh: 爷爷回忆起自己的第一辆自行车，仿佛就在昨天。
items.scene: An old man in an armchair smiles with his eyes closed. A big dreamy thought bubble above him shows himself as a little boy proudly riding a shiny red bicycle in a sunny village street.
items.hook: 回忆的气泡：se souvenir de qch = 记得，回想起。

items.fr: Le chat saute très haut pour [éviter] la flaque d'eau.
items.en: The cat jumps very high to avoid the puddle.
items.zh: 猫跳得很高，好避开那个水坑。
items.scene: On a wet street after the rain, a cat leaps dramatically high over a big puddle, legs stretched out, with a disgusted face. Its reflection shows in the water below.
items.hook: 跳起来绕开不想碰的东西：éviter = 避免，避开。

items.fr: Après une heure devant la carte, il a enfin [décidé] : une pizza !
items.en: After an hour in front of the menu, he finally decided: a pizza!
items.zh: 对着菜单看了一个小时后，他终于决定了：披萨！
items.scene: In a restaurant, a man holds a gigantic menu and points triumphantly at a picture of a pizza. Next to him, the waiter has fallen asleep standing up, and cobwebs hang from his notepad.
items.hook: 犹豫了很久终于拍板：décider (de) = 决定。

items.fr: Le cambrioleur s'est [trompé] de maison : c'est le commissariat !
items.en: The burglar got the wrong house: it's the police station!
items.zh: 小偷弄错了房子：那是警察局！
items.scene: At night, a burglar in a striped shirt and eye mask climbs a ladder and peers through a lit window, only to find a stern police officer with folded arms waiting inside. The building has a blue police light on the roof and police cars parked outside.
items.hook: 他翻窗没错，错的是“选的那一个”：se tromper de + 名词（不加冠词）= 弄错。

items.fr: Le panneau [prévient] les promeneurs : attention aux crocodiles !
items.en: The sign warns walkers: watch out for crocodiles!
items.zh: 标志提醒散步的人：小心鳄鱼！
items.scene: Beside a peaceful pond, a yellow triangular warning sign shows only a crocodile silhouette. A walker reading the sign freezes, while just behind him two crocodile eyes rise out of the water.
items.hook: 事先提醒、警告：prévenir = 提前告知；警告。
